  WHY: Adoption then supplies the successor's closed state without `ai:merged`, so `check-wave-status` marks it failed and the wave judge can open a duplicate redo. Reviewers rated this MAJOR. Sonnet-5_5 and minimax-m3 examined the same path and judged it unreachable or unlikely, so they did not report it.

  WHY: The fail-open contract at lines 29608-29610 ("A failed PR lookup must not read as merged:false") is not honored here, so the successor counts as a closed failure for the tick.
